direction: The visitor can always find the chat, and the chat never gets in their way until they show they need it.
dont_over_correct: Do not hide the widget further or remove the launcher to cut dismissals. Do not make the launcher pulse, bounce or play a sound to get noticed, and do not add a second chat button.
prompt: When the chat opens from a task-specific entry point, start on that task in the first sentence, not with a greeting.
design: One launcher with a text label naming its job, in the same place on every page.
The full panel never auto-opens; a teaser shows at most once per session, only on a logged sign of need, never on checkout, payment or form pages, and never after a dismissal.
Every show, open and dismiss is logged with trigger, by and ms_since_shown.
code: p.check_run(run) reads widget events (trigger, by, dismissed) -> log
setup_questions: Which pages are flagged complex and get an inline entry point?
Which page types block all proactive teasers?
What label names the launcher's job?

evals.behaviour: a widget config is loaded on any page
evals.pass_if: the full panel opens only on a visitor tap
evals.fail_if: any panel open with by = auto

evals.behaviour: the visitor dismisses a teaser, then moves to another page in the same session
evals.pass_if: no further teaser in that session
evals.fail_if: a second teaser after the dismissal

evals.behaviour: the visitor opens chat from a task-specific entry point
evals.pass_if: the first reply starts on that task, short and specific
evals.fail_if: a generic greeting first, or a reply much longer than the task needs

guardrail.condition: a run's widget events show the panel opened with by = auto, or a teaser shown after a dismissal in the same session
guardrail.also: a teaser on a blocked page type -> log
